title: The Cyclotron
description: A charge in a magnetic field circles at a frequency that does not depend on its speed. Kick it at that frequency and it spirals out, faster every turn - until relativity puts it out of step. Unlocks the Cyclotron.

puzzle.goal: A charge q of mass m moves across a uniform magnetic field B. The magnetic force bends it into a circle; write how many times a second it goes round, f.
puzzle.name: Cyclotron frequency
puzzle.ask: Find f in MHz for a proton (q = 1.602e-19 C, m = 1.6726e-27 kg) in B = @{B} T.
puzzle.method: qvB = mv²/r gives r = mv/qB; the time round, 2πr/v = 2πm/qB, does not depend on the speed.
